'''Anj'a''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'Lek]] who worked as an [[entertainer]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. While she declared that she was neutral in the conflict, rumors persisted that she aided the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the war. She graced the covers of every fashion [[Hologram/Legends|holo-mag]] and adorned the screens of every [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] user's [[Computer/Legends|computer]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. She was considered by both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the Rebellion to be the galaxy's most popular holo-pinup girl, much to the dismay of Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officers]].<ref name="SWG" />

Anj'a found the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] fascinating, using one of their energy lances as a dancing prop during her performances. She also owned a suit of custom [[Rancor/Legends|Rancor]] [[Bone/Legends|bone]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that she wore frequently. [[Intense Performer|A painting]] was commissioned of Anj'a performing her number-one galactic hit "[[Booombaaa Boombaa Bombashella]]" at the [[Grand Theater of Vreni Island|outdoor theater]] at [[Vreni Island]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWG" /> Anj'a's song was the only time a release by a non-[[Human/Legends|human]] artist topped the charts under Imperial rule.<ref name="Slughthrowers2">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-part-2|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Anj'a appeared in a painting in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role playing game|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']] and on a card in the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'' set, ''[[Threat of the Conqueror]]''. The painting and card were named ''Intense Performer'' and their artwork was created by the player Anj'a, who won a contest in [[2010]] to have their artwork added to the games. The artwork's appearance as a painting in ''Star Wars Galaxies'' includes a short biography of Anj'a the entertainer.
